integration_method: Isolated checkout of exact Storytold v0.19.1 source; apply the protected WordCraft Android overlay only inside the pinned disposable builder; fail closed on changed anchors; temporary per-run signing; no production key or release publication.
required_preservation: Approved WordCraft launcher icon and compact Wc menu
Stylus hover pointer, pressure ink and customizable PhotoCraft-style wheel
Two-finger touch and trackpad navigation without accidental ink or object selection
Physical keyboard, D/C/S save-dialog shortcuts, Ctrl+W and Ctrl+Q
Persistent font import, 5,000-file / 4 GiB SAF shared font scan
In-app updater and bottom notification UI
File associations, document safety and rendering responsiveness
release_policy: Candidate only. No merge, permanent signing, production package build, tag or publication without explicit user approval.
